svg.title: PGG Engineering / 25 tools
svg.desc: Alphabetical product marks. Afterkey. Afterkey returns the latest value or deletion for each key changed after a reader’s cursor. Backfold. A replacement panel slots into a folded history while the surrounding readings stay in place. CachePin. A pin holds the shared portion of three stacked prompt sheets at a cache breakpoint. CausalSieve. A marked upstream domino leads two later changes, illustrating how CausalSieve ranks incident candidates. ChronoSieve. A change rings a bell, representing the compact digest that can wake a monitoring agent. Cloture. A fan of rollout ballots shows repeated circular votes for the same answer. Cutstream. A blade cuts a stream at a stop sequence that straddles the seam between two chunks. EdgeChime. EdgeChime reports which rectangular zones a moving point enters or leaves between position updates. eproc. A sequence of evidence values rises and falls before crossing a stopping threshold. EventFold. A pleated frame carries a single highlighted edit across successive folds. FlashMP. Two impressions show the same subsequence shape at different levels and amplitudes. Guardshift. Guardshift reports which registered conditions switched on or off after a batch of signal changes. KthWake. KthWake reports when a rolling arrival count crosses a rule’s threshold, including expiration during silence. PathProbe DAG. Two dependency paths converge, with one task highlighted for duration analysis. Prefix Atlas. Nested contour lines represent the cache capacities explored for a target prompt-prefix hit rate. Pulsefold. Pulsefold tracks deadlines for readers that share a heartbeat but tolerate different amounts of silence. Racecurve. A backup request starts later and races the first request toward the same deadline. RankFence. Two groups of ranked streams stop at a common cutoff, leaving later results unread. RankPatch. A vermilion replacement strip slides into a stack of ranked results. RankSeal. A serrated seal encloses three ordered bars to represent a ranking certified from partial lists. RecastCRPS. One forecast bead moves while the other ensemble members and the observed outcome stay fixed. SinceKit. SinceKit builds one changed-key array, and each reader takes the prefix needed for its checkpoint. StreamSieve. Several telemetry channels pass through a sieve, and a marked strip carries the changed channel’s samples. Tailstate. Tailstate pages through the latest changed keys in sequence order from a worker’s acknowledged cursor. tsjit. One incoming reading feeds a fan of nine forecast quantiles.
